project_type: Monorepo: Cloudflare Worker (Edge), Python FastAPI (Backend), React Vite (Frontend)
build_system: pnpm workspaces for Node apps, pip for Python backend
test_framework: vitest for edge/frontend, pytest for backend
build_command: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit
verification_instructions: 1. For edge: run tsc --noEmit on edge worker. 2. For backend: run mypy apps/backend/app/ --ignore-missing-imports. 3. For CI: validate YAML syntax of workflow files.
setup_instructions: 1. corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.26.1 --activate. 2. pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. 3. pip install requirements from apps/backend/requirements.txt (hash-stripped).
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install packages from registries. Use AST/syntax validation only.
contribution_requirements: No specific CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing patterns in the codebase.
key_patterns: Python backend uses pydantic-settings for config, beanie ODM for MongoDB, upstash-redis for caching. CI uses GitHub Actions with pnpm for Node, pip for Python. Edge deploy uses 'wrangler deploy --env production' in deploy-all.yml.
directory_structure: / - monorepo root with pnpm-workspace. apps/edge/ - Cloudflare Worker. apps/backend/ - FastAPI app with app/ (source) and tests/. apps/frontend/ - React Vite app. .github/workflows/ - CI/CD pipelines.
